from pathlib import Path
import json
tid='DEV-PRED-ASTRA-RESULT-NORMALIZE-R5-20261008-N1E134'
root=Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'
rows=[]
if root.exists():
    for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
        if not p.is_file() or tid not in p.name: continue
        try:
            obj=json.loads(p.read_text())
            keep={k:obj.get(k) for k in ['task_id','status','exit_code','source_commit','worktree','branch','commit','local_commit','error','detail','operations'] if k in obj}
            rows.append(p.name+'='+json.dumps(keep,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
        except Exception:
            rows.append(p.name+'='+p.read_text(errors='replace')[:1800].replace('\n',' '))
print('ERROR_CLASS=N1E134_STATUS_EVIDENCE')
print('ERROR='+'|'.join(rows)[:12000])
raise SystemExit(1)
